headerDisplay: Shows ecobee Smart Security as a security system in Apple Home (arm Stay / Away, disarm, alarm state). Unofficial: uses the same ecobee cloud as the app. To get a refresh token, run bin/ecobee-login.js from this plugin's folder (see README).

name.title: Name
name.description: Name shown in the Home app.

refreshToken.title: Refresh token
refreshToken.description: From bin/ecobee-login.js. Only needed again if ecobee signs the plugin out (password change, 'sign out everywhere').

homeId.title: Home ID
homeId.description: Only needed if the account has more than one home; the log lists them.

pollInterval.title: Check every (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to read the armed state, so changes made in the ecobee app or at the keypad show up in Apple Home.
